title: X Algorithm — the actual, open-source code powering the "For You" feed on X
description:
Elon Musk has open‑sourced X’s algorithm!  — the actual source code that decides what shows up on your X feed. For years, this was a black box, but now you can see exactly how the sausage is made. It breaks down the entire pipeline: from "Candidate Generation," where it pulls tweets from people you don't even follow, to the "Heavy Ranker," which calculates the exact mathematical probability of you liking or replying to a post.

https://github.com/xai-org/x-algorithm

#github #opensource
